name: nodeviz
description: A visual canvas for dbt projects: see how your models connect, and sketch new ones as boxes that become .sql files.

nodeviz.openOnStartup.description: Open the canvas next to your code when a dbt project is opened.

nodeviz.projectPath.description: Folder that holds dbt_project.yml, absolute or relative to the workspace. Leave empty to find it automatically.

nodeviz.confirmFileEdits.description: Ask before adding a ref() to an existing .sql file when you connect two boxes.

nodeviz.openCreatedFile.description: Open the new .sql file after Create file.

nodeviz.addToModelsYml.description: On Create file, add '- name: <model>' with an empty description to the folder's models .yml (e.g. _marts__models.yml), when the folder has exactly one .yml with a models: list. Undo removes it again.

nodeviz.dbt.executable.description: The dbt command typed into the NodeViz terminal, or its full path, e.g. ~/.venvs/dbt-databricks/bin/dbt.

nodeviz.dbt.target.description: Added as --target to every dbt command. Leave empty for the profile's default target.

nodeviz.dbt.envFile.description: A file of KEY=VALUE or export lines (e.g. ~/.databricks.env) loaded once into the NodeViz terminal, like running source on it yourself.

nodeviz.integrations.dagtracer.enabled.description: Use DAGtracer (dgt) to trace where a column stops in the DAG, when dgt is installed.

nodeviz.integrations.dagtracer.executabl.description: The dgt command, or its full path, e.g. /home/you/projects/dagtracer/.venv/bin/dgt.

nodeviz.integrations.dagtracer.timeoutSe.description: Stop a dgt run that takes longer than this.

scripts.test: node --test test/lineage-ui.test.js test/model.test.js test/extension.test.js test/removeref.test.js test/dbtrun.test.js test/modelsyml.test.js test/aliases.test.js test/host.test.js test/dagtracer.test.js test/dagtracer-ui.test.js test/architecture.test.js test/release.test.js
